work.position: Language-guided expertise evolution for protein optimization
work.summary: Advisor: Prof. Yanming Shen. Developed a self-evolving agent system for protein optimization through explore–verify–refine cycles, accumulating executable prior knowledge in a code-based knowledge base.
highlights: Represented knowledge as a code population, with gating mechanisms to match and optimize target protein sub-distributions.
Used Thompson sampling during training and lower confidence bound (LCB) scoring for final knowledge selection to balance exploration and exploitation.
Built an agent workspace containing parent-node strategies, validation results, and metrics to support feedback-driven exploration and analysis.
Built a high-concurrency agent system from scratch, decoupling exploration from knowledge updates and supporting multiple servers for efficient resource use.

An early version won the Best Innovation Award at the Bohr + SciMaster AI4S Agent Development Competition (only two teams awarded) and reached the MiraclePlus startup camp interview round (top 10%). This work led to co-first-author papers accepted at ICLR 2026 RSI Workshop and NeurIPS 2026.

work.summary: Advisor: Prof. Yanming Shen. Integrated molecular motifs into GNNs and LLMs to improve representation learning beyond the limits of 1-WL testing and one-dimensional SMILES representations.
highlights: For Uni-Motif, designed and evaluated three substructure feature fusion mechanisms and compared motif decomposition strategies.
For S<sup>2</sup>Token, proposed and evaluated substructure-aware tokenization and reproduced leading baselines to validate motif-augmented performance gains.
Co-authored papers published in *Expert Systems with Applications* and *Information Processing & Management*.

work.position: Protein hydration and crystallization condition prediction
work.summary: Advisor: Prof. Song Xue. Modeled relationships among protein sequences, structures, and chemical environments to predict crystallization conditions.
highlights: Built a crystallization condition database of roughly 7,000 proteins by extracting, filtering, and integrating records from the Protein Data Bank.
Used Foldseek to cluster structurally similar proteins and analyze solution-component combinations and crystallization condition distributions.
Fine-tuned SaProt, a pretrained structure-aware protein language model, on the crystallization condition task.
Found that protein language models struggle to represent crystallization conditions. Current work adds hydration as a downstream modality and develops hydration-aware protein representations.

portfolio.name: Self-Aware Agent: An agent who manages its own context
portfolio.description: Self-aware agent (SAA) is an agent harness that treats context as an explicit inventory of *context items* (containing chat history, tool results, etc.), in which agents can build its own context through folding/unfolding/removing context items.
